text:
The adjacency rules lock two blocks: Ben–Cara–Dev in three consecutive slots, and Hana–Ivo in two consecutive slots, with Ivo before Cara. Finn before Hana by at least three slots forces Hana no earlier than slot 4, which forces Ben–Cara–Dev no earlier than 6–7–8.

Checking those starts, the only placement that still leaves an Elif–Gus pair with exactly one slot between them is Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9 and Hana–Ivo in 5–6, with Finn in 1. Slots 2, 3, and 4 then fall to Elif, Ann, and Gus: Elif before Ivo, Ann before Gus, one slot between Elif and Gus, and Ann three slots from Ivo.

That filling meets every constraint, including Finn and Hana four slots apart. Placing the blocks anywhere else leaves no legal slots for Elif and Gus.
